name: Mindo
tagline: Cloud forest of hummingbirds and chocolate
summary: Mindo is a little village in the cloud forest two hours from Quito, a paradise for birders with over 500 species. Watch dozens of hummingbirds at feeders, ride the tarabita cable car to waterfalls, zipline through the canopy, and tour a bean-to-bar chocolate maker.
seasonNote: Drier June to September; rain is common in the afternoons all year.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus or car from Quito.
cashTip: Ecuador uses US dollars; carry small notes.
